segments.name: Plumbing Products
segments.description: Manufactures and sources faucets, showering products, spas, saunas and plumbing components sold to retailers, wholesalers, distributors and consumers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The businesses in our Plumbing Products segment sell a wide variety of products that are manufactured or sourced by us.

segments.name: Decorative Architectural Products
segments.description: Sells architectural coatings, paint applicators and decorative and functional hardware to do-it-yourself and professional customers through retailers.
segments.evidence: Our Decorative Architectural Products segment primarily includes architectural coatings, including paints, primers, specialty coatings, stains and waterproofing products, as well as paint applicators and accessories.

revenueModel.text: Masco is paid by home center retailers, online retailers, mass merchandisers, wholesalers, distributors and other customers for its branded home improvement and building products, sold primarily for repair and remodel activity.
revenueModel.evidence: These products are sold primarily for repair and remodeling activity and, to a lesser extent, new home construction.
